summary: RankAuthors groups by author_id only. The displayed name is the spelling that author ID carries most often; ties go to the longest spelling, then the alphabetically first.
reason: Grouping by id and name split one OpenAlex author into several rows whenever the name was printed differently, so works and citations were divided. A reprint must keep the id-only grouping and the deterministic name choice.
validated_outcome: go test ./internal/lancet/ asserts one row for an id printed under two names (3 works, 115 citations, most frequent name), separate rows for two ids sharing a name, the longest name on a frequency tie, and the alphabetical name on a length tie. Dropping the LENGTH rule fails only TestRankAuthorsTieLongestNameWins; reversing the name order fails only TestRankAuthorsTieAlphabeticalName. Tests: TestRankAuthorsSameIDOneRow, TestRankAuthorsDifferentIDsStaySeparate, TestRankAuthorsTieLongestNameWins, TestRankAuthorsTieAlphabeticalName.
